tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All other terms & conditions are as per tender documents.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: 1.The bidder should be a Textile Manufacturers (with valid copy of certificate issued by the Ministry of textiles, GoI/ or concerned State Govt or departments / Union Territory) should have average annual turnover of at least Rs.1.40 crores value for preceding continuous 3 years i.e. 2023-24,2024-25 & 2025-26 duly supported by the Audited Statement of Accounts i.e., Manufacturing / Trading and Profit & Loss Account, Balance Sheets for all the three years are eligible to participate in the tender.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- SUBMIT THE DOCUMENTS AS PER THE PREQUALIFICATION CRITERIA OF THE TENDER.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: 2.Submission of samples-Apart from uploading the offer through e-tender the firm should submit the samples of one Blanket with Linen Cloth (with a detachable label including name of firm). Samples will not be returned to the tenderer.3.Sample test-Pre tender sample to be tested at the Textile Committee, established under Textile Ministry, Govt of India. The test reports will be scrutinized by Tender Scrutiny Committee.Only the Commercial offer of the firm, whose sample is approved, will be opened.4.Testing Charges-Bidder should submit Rs. 10,000.00 towards testing charges in the form of DD drawn in favour of the CAO-FA, KSRTC, Bangalore-27 along with the sample to be submitted.
